notes.title: Storylines: April Update
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

We’ve been hard at work behind the scenes, and we’re excited to share a few updates from Fight’N’Jokes: Storylines.

🐔 New Action-Lite Sequences
We've expanded the game with new "action-lite" sequences, like the hilarious chicken chasing quest. These add a fresh layer of gameplay, bringing new mechanics into the world of Storylines and making exploration even more lively and dynamic.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889435/c1b342a6c067c94b290db45496afd592902b41e5.gif[/img]

🎭 New NPC Characters
A few new faces have arrived in town! Alongside the familiar cast, you’ll now meet some new quirky characters who will have their own roles to play in Miopinja’s story.

🧩 New Quest + Interaction Polish
We’ve added an entirely new quest to tie into the action sequences, and we’ve also done a polish pass on Hugo's interactions, adding more personality, smoother animations, and fun new dialogue to his scenes.

🚀 Demo Coming Soon!
We are currently aiming to release the Storylines demo in May or early June! Thank you so much for your patience and support – we’re putting all our love and laughter into making sure it’s worth the wait.

Stay tuned, and don’t forget to wishlist and follow if you haven’t already!
Your support means the world to us. 💖

– The Lighstromo Team

notes.title: Beta Demo Build Update!
notes.notes:
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889435/0ba2d4a8b9ab477462e3632b5fdafe4c8ab30ba2.jpg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889435/8ec4f44bfb8463ed9601a1cadd40c192dc48f1a4.jpg[/img][/url]

Hurray!!!

We've made a lot of fixes based on feedback from our recent live events, and these improvements are now live for our internal beta testers:

[olist]
[*] Controller Support: The demo is fully playable with a controller, including all menus and in-game actions. We're eagerly awaiting feedback from our play-testers using Steam Decks.
[*] Quest System: The quest system has been patched up. No more disappearing quests or sync issues with your actual playthrough.
[*] Config Saving: Changes made in the Options menu are now consistent across all scenes and game sessions.
[*] Localization: The demo has been localized for German and Russian users. While still under testing, we believe 95% of the in-game and menu texts are successfully translated.
[*] Visual Updates: We've implemented a new art pass on our environments, which is particularly noticeable in the izakaya and Strabinja's house.
[*] QTE System Update: We've refined the handling of QTEs. Progressing through a button smash QTE by holding down a button is no longer possible, and we've fixed the issue that allowed character movement during QTE mode.
[*] Animations Update: We've made minor updates to animations to address some clipping issues in the parrot scene.
[/olist]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44889435/ae2d491361b716003cb2fd26defb22092233caf2.gif[/img]

The next steps before the demo's public release include:
[olist]
[*] Optimization Pass: We will continue to optimize the game for smoother gameplay.
[*] Localization: We are planning to add Portuguese and are looking for German-speaking beta-testers. Additionally, we are actively exploring Chinese localization support.
[*] Animation: We aim to enhance character animations by adding facial expressions.
[*] Expanding Interactions: More lines and challenges will be added to character interactions for the demo release.
[*] Extra Characters: We plan to enrich our cast with more NPCs and background characters.
[*] Controller Update: We are working on full controller support, including rebindable controls.
[/olist]

Cheers and love,

Lighstromo and Co.

notes.notes:
